name: Optical Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution Benchmark
description: A comprehensive benchmark and dataset for evaluating image super-resolution methods on optical remote sensing imagery.
evaluation_method: PSNR and SSIM (image quality metrics); sometimes complemented by visual/subjective assessment
typical_sota_score: 25–35 dB (PSNR) for many top methods, depending on scale and dataset
reputation: A domain-specific benchmark proposed for optical remote sensing SR tasks; appears new and has limited adoption outside remote sensing research groups.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on optical imagery; evaluation often uses synthetic downsampling (bicubic) which may not reflect real sensor degradations; performance is sensor- and scale-dependent and susceptible to domain shift.
